segments.sn45.26:1.3: Sappurisañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi sappurisena sappurisatarañca.
segments.sn45.26:1.6: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … micchāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asappuriso”.
segments.sn45.26:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇī, micchāvimutti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asappurisena asappurisataro.
segments.sn45.26:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sappuriso.
segments.sn45.26:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … sammāsamādhi, sammāñāṇī, sammāvimutti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sappurisena sappurisataro”ti.
